svg.title: coderprint: 679k lines of code in use, of 932k written, all time
svg.desc: 678,946 lines of code in use (461,501 in production, 217,445 in tests), of 931,742 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 2,831 commits across all branches, 57 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 2 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 856k lines of code. The bars end on 19OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 43%, Lean 29%, Python 14%, TypeScript 8%, JavaScript 5%, other languages 1%. Of what was written, 73% is kept.
